Brünnhilde, Waltraute, Siegfried. The rock cave (as in the foreplay. Brünnhilde sits at the entrance of the stone chamber, looking at Siegfried's ring in mute senses; overwhelmed by wondrous memory, it covers him with kisses. Further thunder can be heard, she looks up and listens. Then she turns again to the ring. A fiery lightning. She listens anew and peeks at the distance from where a finstre thunderstorm cloud draws to the rock's tail.

Siegfried, Hagen, Gutrune The Rhine is getting more and more colored by the glowing morning red. Hagen makes a twitching movement. Siegfried suddenly emerges, close to the shore, behind a bush. He is in his own shape; he has only the camouflage helmet on his head: he now pulls it off and hangs it in the belt as he steps out.

Gunther, Siegfried, Brünnhilde, Hagen, Gutrune, Mannen, Frauen. Gunther rises with Brünnhilde from the Kahne; the men line up with respect to their receptions. During the following Gunther Brünnhilde leads solemnly at the hand
The hall of the Gibichungen. Gutrune, Hagen, Gunther, Brünnhilde. It is night. Moonlight is reflected on the Rhine. Gutrune steps out of her chamber into the hall.
